text: Gomɗii Alla faabike on -onon gomɗimɓe ɓen- e hoore ayɓe mon sirkooɓe ɓen e hareeji ɗuuɗuɗi, ɗum e wonnde hiɗon fanɗi hiɗon lo'i -tawde on fawino e Alla, etiɗon kadi on haawnoraaki ɗuuɗal mon, wanaa ɗuuɗal mon wonunoo sabu poolgal mon. Ammaa non poolgol nde Hunayni, nde ɗuuɗal mon hawnunoo on, wi'uɗon : "Men foolirtaake fanɗere hannde", kono ngal ɗuuɗal mon duncanaano on hay huunde, ayɓe mon ɓen fooli on, leydi ndin faaɗirani on wa si ndi yaajaa, refti huccuɗon doguɗon ayɓe ɓen.
